title: Fed decision in April?
description:
The FED interest rates are defined in this market by the upper bound of the target federal funds range. The decisions on the target federal fund range are made by the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meetings.

This market will resolve to the amount of basis points the upper bound of the target federal funds rate is changed by versus the level it was prior to the Federal Reserve's April 2026 meeting.

If the target federal funds rate is changed to a level not expressed in the displayed options, the change will be rounded up to the nearest 25 and will resolve to the relevant bracket. (e.g. if there's a cut/increase of 12.5 bps it will be considered to be 25 bps)

The resolution source for this market is the FOMC’s statement after its meeting scheduled for April 28-29, 2026 according to the official calendar: https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm.

The level and change of the target federal funds rate is also published at the official website of the Federal Reserve at https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/openmarket.htm.

This market may resolve as soon as the FOMC’s statement for their April meeting with relevant data is issued. If no statement is released by the end date of the next scheduled meeting, this market will resolve to the "No change" bracket.

eventMetadata.context_description: Polymarket traders' near-unanimous 99.9% implied probability for no change in the federal funds target range at 3.50%-3.75% reflects robust economic data tempering rate cut hopes ahead of today's FOMC April 28-29 meeting conclusion. March CPI surged 3.3% year-over-year—the hottest since May 2024—driven by gas price spikes, while nonfarm payrolls rebounded with 178,000 additions and unemployment held at 4.3%, signaling sustained labor market strength. This aligns with CME FedWatch's 100% hold odds and March FOMC minutes affirming the pause. Realistic challenges include a surprise hawkish Powell press conference or unforeseen geopolitical shocks, though recent communications suggest steady policy through mid-2026.

title: US x Iran ceasefire extended by...?
description:
This market will resolve to “Yes” if there is an official extension of the two-week ceasefire agreement between the United States and Iran announced on April 7, 2026, defined as a publicly announced and mutually agreed extension to the halt in direct military engagement between the United States and Iran, by the specified date, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

Both extensions of the April 7 ceasefire and new agreements scheduled to take effect before or at the initial agreement's scheduled end will be considered extensions of the ceasefire agreement, provided there is no period during which no ceasefire is in effect.

If a qualifying agreement is officially reached before the resolution date, this market will resolve to “Yes,” regardless of whether the ceasefire extension ultimately takes effect. 

An extension of the ceasefire agreement requires clear public confirmation from both the United States government and the government of Iran that they have agreed to halt military hostilities against one another for longer than the initially agreed two-week period, or for an official extension of the ceasefire agreement in place to be otherwise confirmed by an overwhelming consensus of media reporting.

Any form of informal understanding, backchannel communication, de-escalation, or unilateral pause in hostilities without a confirmed agreement on a qualifying extension will not qualify. Similarly, newly agreed-upon humanitarian pauses, limited operational pauses, or temporary tactical stand-downs will not qualify.

A newly agreed-upon broader peace deal will qualify if it includes a qualifying extension of the ceasefire agreement/halt in military hostilities. Agreements that outline future negotiations or de-escalation measures, but do not explicitly commit to extending the ceasefire, will not qualify.

This market’s resolution will be based on official statements from the United States government and the government of Iran. However, an overwhelming consensus of credible media reporting confirming that an official ceasefire extension agreement has been reached will suffice.

eventMetadata.context_description: President Trump indefinitely extended the US-Iran ceasefire on April 21 until Iran submits a unified proposal and negotiations conclude, maintaining the US naval blockade of Iranian ports while Tehran partially reopened the Strait of Hormuz to commercial shipping. This follows the initial two-week truce agreed April 8 after over a month of military exchanges, reflecting diplomatic progress via Pakistani mediation despite Iran's reluctance for immediate follow-up talks. Trader consensus hinges on fragile de-escalation signals, with oil price volatility underscoring risks; key watches include Iranian proposal deadlines, potential second-round summits, blockade enforcement, or proxy actions by Hezbollah that could force further extensions or renewed airstrikes.

eventMetadata.context_description: Trader consensus prices Arsenal FC at 42.5% implied probability to win the Champions League semi-final first leg at Atlético Madrid's Metropolitano, reflecting their dominant 4-0 league-phase victory over Atleti earlier this season and stronger recent UCL form despite an away fixture. Both sides enter with injury concerns—Arsenal without confirmed absentee Kai Havertz (knock) but boosted by positive updates on Eberechi Eze and Riccardo Calafiori fitness in the last 24 hours, while Atlético rule out midfielder Pablo Barrios (hamstring) amid a double injury recovery per Diego Simeone. Atleti's home advantage and Simeone's knockout pedigree balance the scales, supporting 29.5% odds for both a draw and home win in what previews expect as a cagey, low-scoring contest.

title: 2026 FIFA World Cup Winner
description:
This market will resolve according to the national team that wins the 2026 FIFA World Cup.

If at any point it becomes impossible for this team to win the FIFA World Cup based on the rules of FIFA (e.g., they are eliminated in the knockout stage), this market will resolve immediately to “No”.

If the 2026 FIFA World Cup is permanently canceled or has not been completed by October 13, 2026, 11:59 PM this market will resolve to “Other”.

The primary resolution source will be official information from FIFA, however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

eventMetadata.context_description: Trader consensus slightly favors France at 16% implied probability to win the 2026 FIFA World Cup, edging Spain's 15.3% amid a tight cluster at the top, driven by a wave of injuries in the final pre-tournament weeks. Spain's Lamine Yamal faces hamstring recovery doubts after his season-ending knock, while Brazil loses Rodrygo to a torn ACL, eroding their depth despite strong qualifying form. France benefits from a healthy, versatile squad featuring Kylian Mbappé and Ousmane Dembélé, bolstered by solid international break results, with Didier Deschamps' experience in high-stakes knockouts. England (11.1%) and co-defending champions Argentina (8.6%) remain competitive via favorable group paths and talent like Jude Bellingham and Lionel Messi, but widespread injury uncertainty keeps the race wide open across the expanded 48-team field.

title: US x Iran permanent peace deal by...?
description:
This market will resolve to “Yes” if Iran and the United states agree to a permanent peace deal by the specified date, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”. 

A permanent peace deal refers to any agreement which explicitly indicates that military hostilities between the United States and Iran have ended or will permanently cease, or uses equivalent language clearly signaling a lasting end to military hostilities between the United States and Iran. Agreements that are explicitly temporary or which do not include a definitive agreement to end military hostilities between the US and Iran on a lasting basis (e.g. a temporary extension of the two-week ceasefire agreement announced on April 7, 2026), will not qualify.

A qualifying agreement will be considered to have been established if either of the following conditions are met:

- The United States and Iran each sign or formally adopt a written agreement (e.g. a treaty or multi-point agreement) which meets the above criteria.

- Both the governments of the United States and Iran provide clear public confirmation that a qualifying agreement has been definitively established. Negotiations, statements of progress, or other statements which do not constitute a definitive announcement that a qualifying agreement has been reached will not count.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from the governments of the United States and Iran; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

eventMetadata.context_description: US-Iran negotiations for a permanent peace deal remain stalled following a fragile ceasefire extension after US and Israeli strikes on Iranian military and nuclear sites in late February 2026. Iran submitted a new proposal on April 28 to reopen the Strait of Hormuz and delay nuclear talks, which the Trump administration is reviewing amid ongoing US naval blockade pressuring Tehran's oil exports. Prospects dim due to Islamic Revolutionary Guards Corps opposition to concessions, unresolved issues like Hezbollah activities in Lebanon, and President Trump's public warnings for Iran to compromise quickly. No new talks are scheduled, with risks of escalation if the ceasefire lapses or blockade persists, reflecting deep mistrust over sanctions, ballistic missiles, and regional influence.

title: Trump announces end of military operations against Iran by ...?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if President Trump, the US government, or the military publicly and officially announce that their military operations against Iran, initiated on February 28, 2026, have concluded by the listed date. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

Qualifying statements must clearly indicate that the operation has ended. Informal announcements, statements from unnamed sources or leaks will not qualify. 

Written public statements from Donald Trump (e.g. posts from his personal Truth Social account), will count. Videos posted on his social media accounts will also qualify for a "Yes" resolution.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official statements from the US government and/or its official representatives; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

eventMetadata.context_description: President Trump rejected Iran's latest proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz in exchange for lifting the US naval blockade, directing aides to prepare for an extended operation as of April 29 amid stalled nuclear negotiations and de-escalation talks. The 2026 Iran war, sparked by US-Israel airstrikes on February 28 that destroyed much of Iran's air defenses, navy, and missile infrastructure, shifted in mid-April from kinetic strikes—paused under a short truce—to this blockade enforced since April 13 following failed Islamabad diplomacy. Congressional hearings featuring Defense Secretary nominee Pete Hegseth underscore sustained military commitment until Tehran complies with demands on uranium enrichment and regional proxies. Traders assess probabilities based on diplomatic breakthroughs or further escalation signals.

title: What will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit in April 2026?
description: What will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit in April 2026?

markets.question: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (HIGH) $160 in April?
markets.description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if, at any point during April 2026, any 1-minute candle for the Active Month of WTI Crude Oil futures has a final "High" price equal to or above the listed price. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

eventMetadata.context_description: WTI crude oil futures have rallied above $105 per barrel in late April 2026, driven primarily by the United Arab Emirates' shock exit from OPEC after nearly 60 years, undermining cartel unity and stoking supply disruption fears, compounded by escalating Middle East tensions including U.S. threats toward Iran. This seven-session advance, the highest since early April, embeds a substantial geopolitical risk premium despite EIA data revealing a 1.9 million-barrel U.S. crude inventory build for the week ended April 17. Trader consensus prices in persistent supply vulnerabilities over softening global demand projections from the IEA's April report. As the month ends, upcoming EIA weekly status reports and OPEC's monthly oil market update loom as key catalysts for final price extremes.

title: LoL: KT Rolster vs Hanwha Life Esports (BO3) - LCK Rounds 1-2
description:
This market refers to the LoL match between KT Rolster and Hanwha Life Esports in the LCK Rounds 1-2, initially scheduled for April 29 at 6:00AM ET.

This market will resolve to "KT Rolster" if KT Rolster win the match against Hanwha Life Esports.

This market will resolve to "Hanwha Life Esports" if Hanwha Life Esports win the match against KT Rolster.

If the match is canceled (not played at all), ends in a tie, or is delayed beyond 7 days from the scheduled date without a winner determined, this market will resolve to 50-50. 

If the match begins but is not completed, and one team wins due to the opponent's forfeiture, disqualification, or walkover, this market will resolve to the team who wins. 

If the match ends in a forfeit, disqualification, or walkover (team withdraws before the start and the other wins automatically), this market will resolve to 50-50. 

The resolution source for this market will be official information from https://gol.gg/esports/home. However, if https://gol.gg/esports/home has not published final results within 2 hours after the event’s conclusion, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead including video evidence.

In cases where a team’s listed name includes minor discrepancies from the resolution source, this market will resolve based on the underlying real-world match rather than exact name matching. Recognizable abbreviations, alternate or erroneous spellings, sponsor tags, affiliate or academy designations, regional identifiers, and minor formatting differences will be treated as referring to the same team, provided the intended team can be clearly and uniquely identified within the relevant competition. If a listed team name has no reasonable connection to any participating team, or if it matches or could reasonably refer to another team in the same competition such that the intended team cannot be unambiguously determined, this market will resolve 50-50.

eventMetadata.context_description: KT Rolster enters this Week 5 LCK Rounds 1-2 BO3 atop the standings at 8-0 (16-2 games), riding an eight-series win streak with dominant clean sweeps over DRX (2-0) and BNK FEARX (2-0) last week, fueled by PerfecT's top lane stability, Cuzz's jungle aggression, and Bdd's mid lane carry potential. Hanwha Life Esports trails closely at 7-1 (14-4), on a six-win run including 2-0 over DRX and 2-1 versus Nongshim RedForce, leveraging Zeus's top versatility, Kanavi's gank-heavy jungle, and Zeka's mechanical prowess in macro-focused teamfights. No injuries or subs reported; even head-to-head history (KT leads 22-18) underscores a competitive matchup for top seed positioning amid stable patch conditions.

eventMetadata.context_description: Gavin Newsom leads trader consensus at 27% implied probability for the 2028 Democratic presidential nomination, driven by his consistent dominance in early national and California primary polls, including a March commanding lead over Kamala Harris in his home state and a tie among younger Democrats in an April 15 survey. Recent high-profile appearances by Harris in early primary states like South Carolina (April 16) and at the National Action Network convention (April 10), where she signaled interest in running, have not closed the gap amid her post-2024 vulnerabilities. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez's 8.6% reflects progressive base appeal, while Jon Ossoff at 6.5% gains from Senate visibility. In this wide-open field post-midterms, consolidation could hinge on 2026 election results in battleground states, fundraising totals, and national polling shifts favoring governors with executive records over senators or former officials.

title: UEFA Champions League Winner
description: This is a polymarket to predict which club will win the 2025–26 UEFA Champions League (soccer).

markets.question: Will Real Madrid win the 2025–26 Champions League?
markets.description:
This is a polymarket on whether the listed team will win the 2025–26 UEFA Champions League.

This market will resolve to "Yes" if the listed team is officially crowned the winner of the 2025–26 UEFA Champions League. Otherwise, it will resolve to "No".

If at any point it becomes impossible for the listed team to win the tournament (e.g. they are mathematically eliminated), the market will resolve to "No".

If the 2025–26 UEFA Champions League is canceled or not completed by October 1, 2026, this market will resolve to "Other".

The primary resolution source will be official information from UEFA Champions League (https://www.uefa.com/uefachampionsleague/). A consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

eventMetadata.context_description: Trader consensus prices Bayern Munich (31.5%), PSG (30.5%), and Arsenal (27.5%) as near-equals to win the UEFA Champions League, capturing the razor-thin margins in the semi-finals after PSG's record-breaking 5-4 first-leg thriller over Bayern Munich that keeps the tie alive ahead of the Allianz Arena return. Arsenal face a gritty tactical showdown at Atletico Madrid's Wanda Metropolitano tonight, contrasting PSG-Bayern's open attacking spectacle with Simeone's defensive mastery against Arteta's fluid Gunners. Quarter-final knockouts fueled the bunching: Bayern's 5-2 aggregate rout of Real Madrid, PSG's 4-0 demolition of Liverpool, Arsenal and Atletico's narrow edges past rivals, highlighting each side's knockout resilience and home-leg advantages in this fiercely contested final four.

title: Israel x Hezbollah Ceasefire extended by...?
description:
This market will resolve to “Yes” if there is an official extension of the 10-day ceasefire agreement between Israel and Hezbollah announced on April 16, 2026, defined as a publicly announced and mutually agreed extension to the halt in direct military engagement between Israel and Hezbollah, by the specified date, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

Both extensions of the April 16 ceasefire and new agreements scheduled to take effect before or at the initial agreement's scheduled end will be considered extensions of the ceasefire agreement, provided there is no period during which no ceasefire is in effect.

If a qualifying agreement is officially reached before the resolution date, this market will resolve to “Yes,” regardless of whether the ceasefire extension ultimately takes effect.

An extension of the ceasefire agreement requires clear public confirmation from both the Israeli government and Hezbollah that they have agreed to halt military hostilities against one another for longer than the initially agreed 10-day period, or for an official extension of the ceasefire agreement in place to be otherwise confirmed by an overwhelming consensus of media reporting.

Any form of informal understanding, backchannel communication, de-escalation, or unilateral pause in hostilities without a confirmed agreement on a qualifying extension will not qualify. Similarly, newly agreed-upon humanitarian pauses, limited operational pauses, or temporary tactical stand-downs will not qualify.

A newly agreed-upon broader peace deal will qualify if it includes a qualifying extension of the ceasefire agreement/halt in military hostilities. Agreements that outline future negotiations or de-escalation measures, but do not explicitly commit to extending the ceasefire, will not qualify.

This market’s resolution will be based on official statements from the Israeli government and Hezbollah. However, an overwhelming consensus of credible media reporting confirming that an official ceasefire extension agreement has been reached will suffice.

eventMetadata.context_description: US President Donald Trump announced on April 23 that Israel and Lebanon agreed to a three-week extension of the fragile Israel-Hezbollah ceasefire following White House talks, pushing the deadline past mid-May and averting immediate escalation. This builds on an initial truce around April 16, modeled after the 2024 framework where Israeli forces maintain southern Lebanon positions while conducting strikes on Hezbollah targets. Despite the deal, both sides report violations—including Israeli airstrikes on Hezbollah infrastructure and drone attacks, plus Hezbollah rocket fire—highlighting persistent tensions and Hezbollah's defiant statements rejecting full withdrawal demands. Traders watch upcoming US-mediated negotiations and UN monitoring for signs of de-escalation or collapse before the new expiration.

title: Elon Musk # tweets April 24 - May 1, 2026?
description:
This market will resolve according to the number of times Elon Musk (@elonmusk), posts on X from April 24 12:00 PM ET to May 1, 2026 12:00 PM ET.

For the purposes of this market, only main feed posts, quote posts and reposts will count.

Replies will NOT count towards the total - however, replies on the main feed such as https://x.com/elonmusk/status/1786073478711353576 will be counted by the tracker.

Deleted posts will count as long as they remain available long enough to be captured by the tracker (~5 minutes).

Community reposts which are not counted by the tracker not count toward the total.

The resolution source for this market is the 'Post Counter' figure for posts found at https://xtracker.polymarket.com. Individual posts can be viewed by clicking "Export Data". If the tracker does not update correctly in accordance with the rules, X itself may be used as a secondary resolution source.

title: LoL: Team WE vs Bilibili Gaming (BO3) - LPL Group Ascend
description:
This market refers to the LoL match between Team WE and Bilibili Gaming in the LPL Group Ascend, initially scheduled for April 29 at 7:00AM ET.

This market will resolve to "Team WE" if Team WE win the match against Bilibili Gaming.

This market will resolve to "Bilibili Gaming" if Bilibili Gaming win the match against Team WE.

If the match is canceled (not played at all), ends in a tie, or is delayed beyond 7 days from the scheduled date without a winner determined, this market will resolve to 50-50. 

If the match begins but is not completed, and one team wins due to the opponent's forfeiture, disqualification, or walkover, this market will resolve to the team who wins. 

If the match ends in a forfeit, disqualification, or walkover (team withdraws before the start and the other wins automatically), this market will resolve to 50-50. 

The resolution source for this market will be official information from https://gol.gg/esports/home. However, if https://gol.gg/esports/home has not published final results within 2 hours after the event’s conclusion, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead including video evidence.

In cases where a team’s listed name includes minor discrepancies from the resolution source, this market will resolve based on the underlying real-world match rather than exact name matching. Recognizable abbreviations, alternate or erroneous spellings, sponsor tags, affiliate or academy designations, regional identifiers, and minor formatting differences will be treated as referring to the same team, provided the intended team can be clearly and uniquely identified within the relevant competition. If a listed team name has no reasonable connection to any participating team, or if it matches or could reasonably refer to another team in the same competition such that the intended team cannot be unambiguously determined, this market will resolve 50-50.

markets.question: Game 1: Both Teams Slay Baron Nashor?
markets.description:
This market is about whether both teams slay the Baron Nashor at least once during Game 1. Baron Nashor is a powerful neutral objective in League of Legends that first spawns at 20:00 game time and respawns 6 minutes after each death, granting the slaying team the Hand of Baron buff.

This market will resolve to "Yes" if both Team WE and Bilibili Gaming each slay Baron Nashor at least once during Game 1. This market will resolve to "No" if either team (or both teams) does not slay Baron Nashor during Game 1.

If the match is canceled (not played at all) or is delayed beyond 7 days from the scheduled date, this market will resolve to 50-50.

If Game 1 is never played due to forfeit, disqualification, or walkover, this market will resolve to 50-50.

If Game 1 is not played because the series result has already been determined (e.g., a team clinches the series before Game 1 is needed), this market will resolve to 50-50.

If Game 1 begins but is not completed and ends via surrender, this market will resolve based on whether both teams had slain Baron Nashor prior to stoppage. If the condition was not met, this market will resolve to "No".

If Game 1 is remade, resolution will be based on the remade game only.

The resolution source for this market will be official information from https://gol.gg/esports/home. However, if https://gol.gg/esports/home has not published final results within 2 hours after the event's conclusion, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead including video evidence.

markets.question: Game 1: Both Teams Slay a Dragon?
markets.description:
This market is about whether both teams slay at least one elemental dragon during Game 1. In League of Legends, elemental dragons (Infernal, Mountain, Ocean, Hextech, Chemtech, and Cloud) spawn in the dragon pit starting at 5:00 game time. After being slain, the next dragon spawns 5 minutes later. Once a team claims the Dragon Soul (by slaying four dragons), all subsequent dragon spawns become Elder Dragons.

eventMetadata.context_description: JD Gaming enters as trader consensus favorite in this LPL Split 2 Group Ascend BO3 rematch against Ninjas in Pyjamas, reflecting their three-series win streak—including recent 2-0 sweeps over Invictus Gaming and Team WE—after an early stumble, while NIP sits on mixed results with a 2-0 loss to Top Esports two days ago offsetting their prior 2-0 upset over JDG on April 17. Both teams hover around 4-3 in double round-robin play, where a victory bolsters top-4 direct playoff positioning amid Hard Fearless Draft constraints. Stable rosters feature NIP's Guwon and Assum shining lately, countered by JDG's mid-lane edge with HongQ; no injuries or meta-shifting patches reported in the last 48 hours alter the closely contested dynamic.

title: Eurovision Winner 2026
description:
This market will resolve to the country whose candidate for Eurovision 2026 wins.

If at any point it is impossible for the listed candidate to win Eurovision 2026 based on the rules of the competition (i.e. they are eliminated), this market may immediately resolve to "No".

If no winner is announced by July 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve "Other". All ties will be broken according to EBU's official Eurovision rules.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from Eurovision (https://eurovision.tv/), including live footage of Eurovision 2026, however a consensus of credible reporting will suffice.

title: Strait of Hormuz traffic returns to normal by end of April?
description:
This market will resolve to “Yes” if IMF Portwatch publishes a 7-day moving average of transit calls (“Arrivals of Ships”) for the Strait of Hormuz equal to or above 60 for any date between market creation and April 30, 2026. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

Daily transit calls include container, dry bulk, roll-on/roll-off, general cargo, and tanker ships. Ships not reported by IMF Portwatch will not be considered.

This market will resolve as soon as IMF Portwatch publishes a 7-day moving average of transit calls equal to or above the specified level, or once data has been published for the final date in the specified period and no such value has been published. If no data has been published for the final date of the specified period within 14 calendar days (ET) after the end of that period, this market will resolve based on data published up to that point.

Revisions to previously published data points made within this market’s timeframe will be considered. However, they will not disqualify a previously published data point from qualifying. Revisions to previously published data points after data is published for April 30, 2026, however, will not be considered.

The resolution source for this market will be IMF Portwatch, specifically the transit calls data published for the Strait of Hormuz at https://portwatch.imf.org/pages/cb5856222a5b4105adc6ee7e880a1730, both in the chart and through downloadable files.

eventMetadata.context_description: Trader consensus on Polymarket reflects near-certainty at 99.7% market-implied probability for "No," driven by persistent double blockade of the Strait of Hormuz amid the ongoing US-Iran conflict, with shipping data confirming traffic remains at a virtual standstill—limited to rare Iran-linked tankers—as of April 29, 2026. A US blockade on Iran-related vessels imposed April 13, coupled with Iran's renewed restrictions after a brief April 21 reopening that collapsed the next day, has throttled the vital chokepoint carrying 20% of global oil flows, spiking crude prices toward $110 per barrel per analyst projections. Absent a surprise diplomatic breakthrough or ceasefire before month's end, normalization appears impossible; tail risks include abrupt de-escalation talks or unilateral stand-downs, though escalating naval patrols diminish such odds.

title: Who will be confirmed as Fed Chair?
description:
This market will resolve according to the next individual formally confirmed as Chair of the Federal Reserve.

Formal confirmation as Chair of the Federal Reserve requires the Senate to confirm a nominee as Chair of the Federal Reserve. Recess appointments without Senate confirmation will not count. Senate confirmation of a listed individual as a member of the Federal Reserve Board of Governors will not alone qualify.

If no Senate confirmation for the position of Chair of the Federal Reserve has occurred by December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "Other".

The primary resolution source for this market is official information from the U.S. Senate; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

eventMetadata.context_description: Kevin Warsh's overwhelming trader consensus as next Federal Reserve Chair reflects his advancement through the Senate Banking Committee on a 13-11 party-line vote earlier today, clearing a critical hurdle ahead of a full Senate confirmation expected before Jerome Powell's term expires in mid-May. President Trump's March nomination gained momentum after Sen. Thom Tillis lifted his hold last week and Warsh navigated a contentious April 21 confirmation hearing, pledging Fed independence amid scrutiny over potential policy shifts like tighter monetary stance. With Republican Senate majority, confirmation appears routine, though scenarios like bipartisan holds, procedural delays, or late revelations could still derail it.

eventMetadata.context_description: Vice President JD Vance holds a slim lead in trader consensus for the 2028 presidential election at 18.9%, bolstered by his high-profile diplomatic wins—including Iran ceasefire talks, India-Pakistan peace brokering, and a U.S. nuclear deal in Armenia—plus dominant showings in recent GOP straw polls like CPAC (53%) and Yale electability surveys (83%). California Governor Gavin Newsom trails closely at 17.6% as the emerging Democratic frontrunner, gaining from strong California primary polling over Kamala Harris and national visibility amid party soul-searching post-2024. Marco Rubio's 11.3% reflects rising GOP appeal in surveys. The tight field stems from early-stage uncertainty two years before primaries, with 2026 midterms poised to reshape nominations via House and Senate control, Trump endorsements, fundraising momentum, or scandals.

title: Fed Decision in June?
description:
The FED interest rates are defined in this market by the upper bound of the target federal funds range. The decisions on the target federal funds range are made by the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meetings.

This market will resolve to the amount of basis points the upper bound of the target federal funds rate is changed by versus the level it was prior to the Federal Reserve's June 2026 meeting.

If the target federal funds rate is changed to a level not expressed in the displayed options, the change will be rounded up to the nearest 25 and will resolve to the relevant bracket. (e.g. if there's a cut/increase of 12.5 bps it will be considered to be 25 bps)

The resolution source for this market is the FOMC’s statement after its meeting scheduled for June 16-17, 2026 according to the official calendar: https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm.

The level and change of the target federal funds rate is also published at the official website of the Federal Reserve at https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/openmarket.htm.

This market may resolve as soon as the FOMC’s statement for their June meeting with relevant data is issued. If no statement is released by the end date of the next scheduled meeting, this market will resolve to the "No change" bracket.

eventMetadata.context_description: Trader consensus on Polymarket assigns a 93.5% implied probability to no change in the federal funds target range at the June 16-17 FOMC meeting, reflecting resilient economic data amid resurgent inflation pressures. March 2026 CPI surged to 3.3% year-over-year—the highest since May 2024—driven by a 0.9% monthly jump, while the unemployment rate dipped to 4.3%, signaling a robust labor market that diminishes rate-cut urgency. The Fed's current 3.50%-3.75% stance, reaffirmed at today's April 28-29 meeting, aligns with CME FedWatch probabilities near 96% for steady policy. Upcoming May 12 CPI and nonfarm payrolls could challenge this if inflation cools sharply or job growth falters, though geopolitical risks like the Iran conflict bolster hold expectations.

title: Kharg Island no longer under Iranian control by...?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if Kharg Island is no longer under Iranian control by March 31, 2026 11:59PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

“No longer under the control of Iran” means that Iran no longer exercises primary governmental or military control over Kharg Island, and another state, occupying force, or internationally backed authority has established control over the island.

Temporary raids, isolated landings, special operations, bombardment, sabotage, naval presence offshore, or temporary disruption of Iranian activity will not qualify on their own.

An announcement, threat, or claim that Iran has lost control will not qualify without actual control being established.

If control changes pursuant to a negotiated settlement, ceasefire term, surrender, or transfer agreement, this will qualify only once actual control has been established on the island.

If control over Kharg Island is contested, unclear, disputed, or not sufficiently established by the resolution date, this will not qualify, and the market will resolve to “No”.

The primary resolution source will be official statements from the relevant governments and militaries, along with a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: US-Iran diplomatic talks remain stalled at an impasse over Iran's nuclear program, sanctions relief, and control of the Strait of Hormuz, with no confirmed in-person meeting in the past week despite mediation efforts in Pakistan and Oman. Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi blamed Washington for recent failures during a meeting with Russian President Vladimir Putin two days ago, while the US is reviewing Tehran's latest proposal to reopen the strait. Trump administration envoys, including Steve Witkoff, were dispatched to Islamabad five days ago amid reports of Iranian outreach, but Pakistani officials confirmed no direct encounter occurred. Traders monitor escalation risks from ongoing Israel-Hezbollah clashes and potential US naval actions, with upcoming rounds possibly in neutral venues like Oman shaping near-term probabilities.
